title: Dual pencil law fuses F3 incidence with F15 vanishing-Schur; Dickson residual
evidence: Three exact finite-field probes over mu_n at PROPER-subgroup large primes (q=1 mod n, q~n^4..n^5, (q-1)/n in [516, 65538]). scripts/probes/_407_conn/C089_pencil_bridge_and_scale.py + C089_actual_structure.py. (PROVEN piece 1 - the attack-plan bridge) c_T = <lambda^T, .> verified for k=1..7, 1400 random (k+1)-subsets over F_12289, ZERO mismatches; this matches the in-tree fact that cT = lcoeff_k . Lagrange.interpolate = sum_{i in T} u_i / prod_{j in T\i}(x_i-x_j) = the dualVec pairing, so MCASecondMoment's collision functional c_T IS the dual-pencil vector lambda^T. (PROVEN piece 2 - the Lean pencil law mod q) For disjoint pairs P,Q,R -> 4-subset duals lambda^{P|Q},lambda^{P|R},lambda^{Q|R}, the confusion matrix [coll&dep, coll&indep, ncoll&dep, ncoll&indep] = (40,0,0,380) at mu_8 (q=4129) and (1328,0,0,118792) at mu_16 (q=65617): collinear-(e,m) <=> lambda linearly dependent holds EXACTLY mod q, reproducing MCADualPencilLaw.dependent_iff_collinear and its docstring's '40 dependent at mu_8'. (PROVEN piece 3 - the slanted census) slanted (collinear, non-vertical, non-horizontal) disjoint triples = 16 at n=8, 544 at n=16 mod q, exactly matching the char-0 census in probe_slanted_stratum_census.py / DISPROOF_LOG 2026-06-11. (THE CRUX) The entire (e,m)=(sum,product) plane, pencil collinearity, and Dickson-curve sections m=zeta^s => e=zeta^j+zeta^{s-j} are STRUCTURALLY LOCKED at k=3 (4-subsets = unions of disjoint pairs): a pair has exactly two symmetric functions (e,m), so its configuration is a 2D plane and 'collinearity' is meaningful. At the PRIZE rates k=rho*n (rho in {1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16}) the functionals c_T are for (k+1)-subsets of size rho*n+1 >> 4, whose invariant is the full (k+1)-tuple of elementary symmetric functions -- there is no 2D plane, no pencil, no Dickson curve. The pencil law says nothing for k != 3, so the F3/F15/F12 fusion is a clean fixed-k=3 incidence identity that does NOT count #bad scalars at prize scale.
honest_note: The connection's three PROVEN pieces are real and reproduced exactly mod q at proper-subgroup large primes (no #400 full-group/small-prime false positive). But (i) the slanted-Dickson 'residual' the connection points at is ALREADY decided at probe grade (DISPROOF_LOG 2026-06-11: chord-law + shape-I/II seeds under the affine-Galois group i->u*i+c generate 16/16 and 544/544, zero unexplained), so it is not an open prize residual; (ii) the whole apparatus is dimensionally locked at k=3 and is disconnected from the prize regime k=rho*n. The C089 record itself lists walls=[] (it does not claim to weld to BGK). So: the fusion identity is genuinely PROVEN, but as a route to delta* it neither extends past k=3 nor reaches the BGK sqrt-cancellation core. Not a closure; no fabrication. NOT shown: any k!=3 generalization of the pencil law, any link from the k=3 census to the prize #bad-scalar count.
reduced_to: If the pencil/(e,m) census is to bear on the prize, the open task is to define and count the analogue of the wide matroid circuits of (k+1)-subset functionals c_T at k=rho*n: the codim-1 vanishing locus of the elementary-symmetric configuration (e_1,...,e_{k+1}) over mu_n, replacing 2D collinearity. That object is NOT a planar incidence census and reduces to the same #distinct-c_T(u0) / Gauss-sum count as the rest of the program; the k=3 pencil law gives no leverage on it.
